name: Frank DeMao
bio:
Frank DeMao is a highly skilled tattoo artist specializing in realism and black & gray styles that bring your visions to life with meticulous detail and shading. Operating out of Bent-N-Twiztid Tattooing in Willington, CT, Frank maintains a spotless and hygienic workspace, ensuring the utmost cleanliness for every client's peace of mind. With his years of dedication to the craft, a visit to Frank for your next tattoo means you're in the hands of a true professional.
